Hymn 321: Ye Who Are Called to Labor
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Daniel B. Towner
Lyricist/Text Author: Mary Judd Page
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 321 titled "Ye Who Are Called to Labor" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Daniel B. Towner and the lyrics were written by Mary Judd Page.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
